title: LLM Prompt Evaluation for Educational Applications
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The evaluation focuses on the quality of LLM-generated follow-up questions in an educational dialogue context, specifically assessing format, dialogue support, and appropriateness for learners.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on evaluating LLM prompt engineering for educational applications.
